scope: Warm synthetic fixtures created once in a separate process; identical files for baseline/candidate. No cache flush or allocator trim. No model/GPU. Baseline production algorithm with phase hooks only, compiled against current additive stats layout. Candidate success paths use same platform library. C++ counts are requested ordinary new/new[] bytes, not all malloc/native allocations or RSS. /proc samples add reads and runtime overhead; exclusive phase times exclude that overhead. Final benchmark later adds post-destruction zero counters outside the measured scopes. All original logs retained here.
